basic_info.description: Welcome to this sun-filled, two-level condo in a modern 2-unit building, offering an ideal blend of comfort, style, and convenience. This beautifully designed 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath home features a thoughtful layout with distinct living, dining, and entertaining spaces separate from the private bedroom level. The upper level boasts a spacious, south-facing living room filled with natural light, seamlessly opening to a private terrace perfect for outdoor dining, relaxation, and soaking in the stunning bay views. The chef's kitchen is a culinary dream, featuring premium appliances including a Viking gas range, Sub-Zero refrigerator, and Bosch dishwasher, complemented by rich cherry wood cabinetry and sleek stone countertops. A convenient guest powder room completes this level. Downstairs, the private bedroom level offers two generously sized bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bath and abundant closet spaces. The primary suite exudes tranquility with plantation shutters and serene outlooks. In-floor radiant heating, hardwood floors throughout the main living areas, in-unit laundry, and exceptional quiet provided by concrete walls and floors for peace and privacy. Two-car parking, ample storage, and low HOA dues.
